text: Enjoy the best of coastal living in this beautifully renovated 4-bedroom, 4-bath home, where contemporary design, an open floor plan, and exceptional indoor-outdoor lifestyle come together. Thoughtfully reimagined across two levels, the home offers light-filled interiors, stylish finishes, and versatile spaces designed for everyday living. The bright upper level showcases wide-plank flooring and an expansive, open-concept design that connects the living, dining, and kitchen areas. A modern linear fireplace adds warmth to the living area, while skylights and generous windows fill the space with natural light. The kitchen features a waterfall quartz island, sleek cabinetry, and a garden-facing window with views of Sutro Tower, along with direct access to the outdoor living area. The primary suite features French doors opening onto the expansive terrace and a chic en-suite bath. An additional bedroom and a well-appointed full bathroom complete the upper level. The lower level offers further living space with a relaxed family room and two bedrooms, both with garden access. One bedroom serves as a second primary suite with a stylish en-suite bath, providing added privacy and flexibility for guests. A fourth full bathroom and convenient laundry closet with side-by-side washer and dryer add functionality, while the attached garage provides additional storage. With access from both levels, the outdoor spaces are a natural extension of the home. The generous terrace is located just off the kitchen and primary bedroom, while the landscaped garden offers a level lawn and lush greenery. At the rear of the property, a detached studio provides added flexibility as a home office, creative space, or private retreat. Blending fresh, refined design with versatile living spaces and exceptional indoor-outdoor connections, 2270 40th Avenue offers a distinctive opportunity to enjoy San Francisco's coastal lifestyle. Ideally situated in Outer Parkside, the home enjoys easy access to Ocean Beach, Sunset Dunes, excellent nearby schools, neighborhood parks, playgrounds, and the vibrant cafs, restaurants, and shops along Noriega, Taraval, and Irving Streets.

text: On the market for the first time in 50 years, 1749-1751 9th Avenue is a charming 1911 Edwardian residence on a coveted block in Golden Gate Heights bordering the Inner Sunset. Set on an extra-wide 43-foot lot, this cherished property offers an ideal family compound with exceptional flexibility and endless potential to make it one's own. The main house at 1749 features 4 spacious bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms and approximately 2,770 sq. ft. across 3 levels, plus a separate 1-bed and 1-bath garden-level studio, bringing the combined living space to approximately 3,215 sq. ft. per graphic artist/floor plan. A welcoming foyer opens to a gracious living room overlooking the tree-lined street and flows into a formal dining room with a wood-burning stove set within the original stone fireplace surround. Beautifully preserved period details include rich Douglas Fir floors, coved ceilings, custom built-ins with stained glass doors, ornate ceiling medallions and pocket doors. The spacious kitchen features a breakfast nook, adjacent laundry room and powder room, plus new French doors opening to an extra-wide deck with stairs leading to the garden and detached cottage. Upstairs, the second level offers 3 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, including a bright east-facing bedroom that can serve as a second primary en-suite with 2 closets. Two additional garden-facing bedrooms, one with an adjoining office/flex room and walk-out deck, plus a hallway linen closet complete this level. The top floor is dedicated to an expansive primary suite with vaulted ceilings, full bathroom, 3 closets and a private deck with partial views of the Golden Gate Bridge, de Young Museum, Sutro Tower and USF. Unit 1751 is a fully detached cottage offering approximately 645 sq. ft. with 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom, living room, kitchen, laundry area and private patio. Together, the oversized grounds and additional living spaces provide exceptional versatility for multigenerational living, extended guests, a live-in nanny, home office or private practice. A generous 1-car garage with workshop area, ample storage, additional driveway parking, and owned solar panel system complete this property. Located just blocks from the popular cafs, restaurants, shops and Sunday farmers market along Irving Street, and 5 blocks from Golden Gate Park. With a Walk Score of 98 and easy N-Judah access to Downtown and Ocean Beach, this prime location offers the best of San Francisco neighborhood living.

The soul of San Francisco is not found in its iconic high-rises, in its commerce and trade, nor even in its unparalleled innovation and incomparable material wealth. The soul of our great City is found in the homes of all our neighbors: Gathering around the kitchen table, cuddling around the fireplace, tinkering in the garage, and laboring in the garden. The immutable soul of San Francisco lives in the myriad neighborhoods of our ever-changing City, and in homes like 80 Ulloa Street. For nearly nine decades, the men and women that have lived in this home have been among those that have defined our City's strength, and labored to create our City's wealth. A strength and wealth from which we all still benefit. The understated elegance and soul of homes like 80 Ulloa Street still attract those creators, and artists, and dreamers that, generation after generation, add to the fabric of our Golden City. The classic Forest Hill Extension home at 80 Ulloa is in the immediate vicinity of West Portal's neighborhood shops and restaurants, of public transportation, of public parks and playgrounds, and of freeways leading in all directions. While the home's next owners will surely want to add their own upgrades and improvements, every visitor will see that the home has been well loved and well maintained for decades. With good bones, Urban and Pacific Ocean views, and an abundance of light and air as a result of its unique setting directly adjacent to the idyllic tree-lined Sydney pathway, that joins Ulloa Street to Idora Street below it to the northwest, this fully detached home is truly a delight to behold.

Celebrate the holidays at 815 24th Ave! From the instant you step through the front door of this warm and inviting home, you are greeted by a comforting blend of modern touches and timeless character. The elegant dining room immediately captures your attention with its original built-in china hutch, drenched in a serene shade of green that feels both timeless and on-trend. The heart of the home is the very chic kitchen, impeccably outfitted with custom cabinetry, designer tile work, and sleek Silestone countertops that together create a refined yet highly functional workspace. A premium Bertazzoni gas range and hood anchor the room with a professional, chef-worthy presence, elevating everyday cooking. There is a dedicated beverage center with a built-in wine fridge and an advanced Zip water system. From a single elegant countertop faucet, you can instantly access filtered boiling, chilled, or sparkling water, making everything from morning tea to evening cocktails effortless. Just off this space there is a perfectly appointed powder room and easy access to the backyard retreat. A lovely den overlooks the garden and is and ideal setting for a home office. A gorgeous, light-filled front living room completes the main level, anchored by an original fireplace. The bedroom level features an opulent primary suite with ample closet space and a beautifully designed en-suite bathroom. Two additional bedrooms plus a sunroom provide remarkable versatility and the central full bathroom is a true delight, with a cheerful selection of tile and beautifully designed storage. At the garden level an added bonus awaits: a wonderfully appointed guest space perfect for extended family stays or visiting friends. Direct and easy access to the home's backyard sanctuary makes it even more appealing, seamlessly blending indoor comfort with outdoor enjoyment. The home included a one car garage with interior access and this idyllic location is next to the endless trails of Golden Gate Park and the slow street of Cabrillo. This is a must see!

Two generous bedrooms open to a large deck leading down to the backyard, alongside a modern tiled bath with walk-in shower. Downstairs, a flexible office or home gym, laundry area, and family room with direct access to the covered patio and yard sit alongside a private third bedroom and a modern bath with shower over tub. Recessed lighting, wide-plank wood floors, and double-pane windows run throughout, and a large one-car garage with parking in the driveway completes the picture. Stonestown, Brooks Park, H Mart, and bustling Ocean Avenue with its many restaurants and Whole Foods are minutes away, as well as Muni, 280, and BART which make commuting a breeze. A turnkey home like this is a rare find in the City!

Welcome to 21 Vienna Street, a charming San Francisco home offering comfortable living and versatile bonus space! Featuring 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, and 936 sq. ft. of living space, this inviting home showcases beautiful hardwood floors, abundant natural light, and a spacious living room perfect for entertaining. The updated kitchen features rich wood cabinetry, granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, generous counter space, and a convenient breakfast bar. Two comfortable bedrooms and an updated bathroom complete the main level. A standout feature is the finished full basement, offering flexible additional space ideal for a home office, family room, recreation area, or creative retreat. The private rear yard features a patio for outdoor entertaining and plenty of potential for gardening or landscaping. Situated on a 2,500 sq. ft. lot, this home combines classic San Francisco charm, functional living spaces, and endless possibilities. A wonderful opportunity to make this home your own!

Owner-occupy or invest in this rare mixed-use 3-unit, steps from vibrant Fillmore street shops and restaurants, with an estimated $213k in projected annual income. A wonderful full-floor 3-bedroom, 1.5 bath flat is to be delivered vacant. The building consists of a ground floor commercial unit with a stable tenant, Russian Hill Dog Grooming, and two residential units above, making this 3-story, 4200 SF building perfect for pure investment, 1031 exchange with rent upside, or an owner-occupant seeking a premier lower Pacific Heights location. With just one owner since 1991, the property has been heavily upgraded with over $200k in recent improvements, and an eye toward preserving its period charm (custom Andersen windows, remodeled kitchens and baths, and modernized electrical/ HVAC/ plumbing). The expansive residential units, a top-floor 3/1 and the vacant 3/1.5, encompass an entire floor each and have access to private decks. Don't miss this opportunity to own a slice of classic San Francisco.

Priced to sell at $1,300,000 as a buy-it-now opportunity, 3426A 19th Street is a top-floor flat just blocks from Dolores Park, flooded with light from large windows and generous skylights throughout. This 2-bedroom, 2-bath TIC was fully renovated with an open floor plan and thoughtfully redesigned layout that places the primary suite at the rear, buffered from the main living area by a guest room and full hallway bath. The home features tall ceilings and wide-plank white oak flooring, with sleek modern finishes from the bathroom vanities to the quartz waterfall island that anchors the kitchen. Both bedrooms feature large closets with fitted custom millwork; the primary includes an ensuite bathroom and bonus office space with access to the roof and ground floor via a shared back staircase. A large deeded ground-floor storage room with lighting and power suits storage, a workshop, or a small gym, with leased parking available nearby. ButterflyMX, Sonic Fiber, central heat and AC, in-unit laundry, and shared roof access round out the amenities. Building upgrades include seismic, systems, and roof. Set between Valencia and Mission, with Lazy Bear on the same block and Dandelion Chocolate and Tartine Bakery nearby, this is a turnkey home in one of San Francisco's most vibrant neighborhoods.

Imagine Excelsior. A little more sunshine, a little more space, and a neighborhood full of character waiting to be discovered. Welcome to 422 Vienna Street, a charming and beautifully maintained 2-bedroom, 1-bath home offering approximately 1,000 square feet of comfortable living. Classic San Francisco details meet thoughtful updates, including refreshed kitchen and bathroom floors, new kitchen appliances, and double-pane windows. The real magic is out back: a beautifully landscaped garden, perfect for outdoor dining, entertaining, gardening, or simply soaking up the sunshine. Downstairs, a spacious garage level with excellent ceiling height offers remarkable versatilityroom for a casual hangout, workshop, laundry, and storage, with direct access to the garden and exciting possibilities for the future. Beyond the front door, discover the personality of Excelsior: colorful murals, independent coffee shops, neighborhood wine bars, beloved pupuserias, Vietnamese sandwiches, sushi, Thai food, and an eclectic collection of local businesses. All set among quiet residential streets with a genuine sense of community.

agent: Sotheby's International Realty - San Francisco Brokerage
text: Sunlit rooms, rich architectural details, and a professionally designed remodel make this top-floor two-bedroom plus office home an inviting Inner Richmond retreat. Hardwood floors, classic moldings, and beautiful built-ins preserve its original charm, while carefully selected updates bring a fresh, cohesive feel throughout. In the living room, expansive windows fill the space with light, and a brick fireplace flanked by original cabinetry creates a welcoming setting to gather or unwind. The remodeled kitchen is expansive, complete with a 36-inch range, multiple preparation areas, and a coffee bar ready to help get your mornings started. Two welcoming bedrooms offer comfortable spaces to retreat, while a separate office provides dedicated room to work from home. The refreshed bathrooms feature thoughtfully selected finishes, complemented by in-unit laundry. With Golden Gate Park and the best of Clement Street's shops, cafs, and restaurants within easy walking distance, this move-in-ready home offers a wonderful setting for everyday San Francisco living. Includes large deeded storage.

Sophisticated and stylish three-bedroom, two and a half-bath single family home with spectacular views showcasing the perfect floor plan in a prime Portola location! The contemporary facade sets the tone for this tastefully updated home starting with an inviting entryway that leads to a grand open living space with gorgeous wood floors, views, and never-ending natural light. The main level has a large sunken living room with a fireplace, a festive dining area, a conveniently located half-bath, and a large gourmet eat-in kitchen with direct access to the backyard/garden/patio accentuating indoor/outdoor living. The serene and tranquil backyard/garden/patio with mature landscaping and fountain offers the perfect ambience whether entertaining, or simply seeking peaceful repose. The dramatic staircase with skylight is showered with natural light and leads to the sought-out floor plan where there are three spacious bedrooms and two bathrooms on one level. The first of three bedrooms is a massive master bedroom suite with double closets, a sitting area, en-suite bathroom and spectacular views. There are two additional bedrooms on this level, both with ample amount of closet space and overlooking the backyard/garden/patio, and a full bathroom. The cavernous garage space with plenty of room for storage adds the final touches to the special home that is close to shopping, cafes, restaurants, public transportation, HWY 101/280 and more.
